data.text/markdown:
eval results across models

Plots every model scored by scripts/eval.py (and eval_slor_manual.py) in eval_output/. CHILDES-formatted runs (--childes-format) are drawn as triangles beside each model's circle; dark mean dots and the hardest-assertion ranking use normative results only. Results scored on an older pairs.csv are skipped with a warning (re-run eval.py). Figures go to figures/.

data.text/markdown:
Accuracy by phenomenon and group

Critical assertions on the left, control on the right, sharing the y axis. Each dark dot is the mean across models with a 95% bootstrap CI over assertions; lighter dots are single models. Phenomena are ordered by mean critical accuracy; groups (group_id from pairs.csv) by id.

Hardest assertions

The assertions with the lowest mean margin across models (rank 1 diff ||(-||) rank 2 diff, in log-prob per token; above 0 means correct), restricted to the condition picked above, and at most two per group. Dark dots carry a 95% bootstrap CI over models. The full ranking (with no per-group cap) is written beside the figure as plot_hardest_assertions.csv.

data.text/markdown:
Differences vs. pairwise

Accuracy on pairs.csv (differences of differences) against pairs_pairwise.csv (plain minimal pairs), one panel per model that has both eval_results-<model>.csv and pairwise_eval_results-<model>.csv: a row per phenomenon (critical), then overall critical and overall control, with the two accuracies joined by a line.
